content.text: When it comes to a luxury experience, Delhi has to be the perfect destination. Known for its mouth-watering street food, culturally rich heritage sites, and vibrant atmosphere, the national capital offers an unforgettable experience to everyone. The grandeur of Delhi is further amplified by its incredible collection of phenomenal 5-star hotels. If it is the luxurious experience you are looking for, with a hospitable staff, a relaxing environment, and a wholesome royal experience then head on to Delhi. The lavish lawns, elegant interiors, and high-end restaurants teamed up with a welcoming vibe may just be the thing that you need to hit that refresh button and feel rejuvenated inside out. These hotels are ideal for not just staying during vacations but also hosting wedding ceremonies and other such important events. What better way of making an impression? Check out these 30 best 5-star hotels near me in Delhi and experience Delhi like never before.

Ever since its opening in 1986, The Leela Palace has been redefining the unparalleled luxury experience. Headquartered in Mumbai, the Leela is a much-loved 5-star hotel in Delhi along with many other flagship branches panning across the subcontinent. The Leela is all about representing the unique culture, art, and cuisine through its stylish interiors as well as cuisines. Offering a rich immersive experience it has won several awards for its incredible services including the world’s best hotel. This 5-star hotel in Delhi is committed to providing unforgettable stays to every guest.

The very first chapter of the Oberoi can be traced back to as early as 1934 in Shimla. The founder had the vision of opening a luxurious hospitality experience. Over generations now, The Oberoi has stood tall as one of the most iconic, celebrated, and well-established 5-star hotels in Delhi along with the rest of India and the world. Every property is curated towards providing a luxury getaway experience. From the rooms to the restaurants and services, everything is truly exceptional.

Holding a distinguished place among one of the most royal 5-star hotels in the national capital, the Taj Mahal Hotel in New Delhi is a masterpiece. Lovingly referred to as the capital’s palace since 1983, the hotel covers a lush area of over 6 acres complete with neatly trimmed and well-maintained lawns, timeless architectural beauty, and incredible hospitality that will make you keep going back for more. The New Delhi Taj Mahal Hotel offers incredible views of the surrounding Delhi greenery and natural beauty at its best. All this teamed up with rich cultural Indian art, warmth, and personalized services makes this iconic hotel truly a one-of-a-kind experience.

Situated conveniently 4 kms away from the Indira Gandhi International Airport in Aerocity, Lemon Tree is all about giving its guests a plush experience. This luxurious stay comes with a wonderfully relaxing swimming pool, spa massage experience, and many other such interesting amenities primarily geared toward providing every guest with a rejuvenating experience. Don’t miss out on your day of working out in the well-equipped gym that also comes with a personal trainer.

Located just a couple of minutes away from the international airport of Delhi, this top-notch 5-star hotel in Delhi deserves some much-needed attention. With Holiday Inn, it’s not just about the hotel and stay it’s about having a wholesome and deeply immersive experience. Guests can enjoy shopping at the nearby malls of DLF promenade or ambiance or even go on a complete Delhi Darshan. All you have to do is connect to their travel desk and you are good to go.

Andaz is a popular concept hotel by Hyatt focussed on offering a rich and royal stay experience. The unique art pieces installed in the hotel create an immersive travel experience that will make you fall in love with the city. Studded with an incredible pool, a well-equipped fitness center, and a spa therapy center, a stay at Andaz will leave a lasting impression for sure. Make sure to book the airport-facing window room, if you can, for the best stay experience.

Been a while since you treated yourself? This is your sign to book a room at the Leela ambiance and enjoy a day full of self-love and care. The hotel is an award-winning property designed solely to offer a wonderful holiday experience, no matter where you are coming from. The first chapter of the Leela Ambiance was written in 1986 and ever since then, it has dominated the luxury 5-star hotel category in India and the world. The captivating environs wrapped with the sweet welcoming arms of Indian hospitality make a stay here well worth it.

When it comes to bespoke 5-star hotels in Delhi, JW Marriott’s name comes first to mind. Situated very close to the DLF promenade, in the Delhi Aerocity area, the hotel boasts incredible amenities and top-notch services. The spa center deserves special mention for its international standards of spa treatment experience. The perfect hotel where you can relax your day away while feeling your stress melt too. The on-site international cuisine restaurant along with professional yoga makes for a well-rounded stay experience.

The heart of Delhi is the location for this iconic 5-star hotel. Overlooking the well-preserved green ridge area of Delhi. Featuring an award-winning spa and a 24-hour open fitness center, a relaxing vacation in Delhi is guaranteed. Its nearness to the local heritage attractions of Red Fort , Tughlakabad Fort, etc. makes it a sought-after hotel among travel enthusiasts. The rooms of Crowne Plaza deserve a special mention for being soundproofed and representing a combination of modern and contemporary looks. The hotel offers round-the-clock room service along with top-notch international restaurants serving delectable cuisine selections.

The imperial New Delhi is all about reminiscing and recreating the 19th-century royal vibe. Opened in 1936, stepping into the hotel will take you to the era of Marajas and maharanis. The architecture is focused on showcasing traces of Victorian, Art Deco, and typical Lutyens style. One does not simply stay at the imperial, they have a whole world of experience. The antique chandeliers and rosewood furniture leave no stone unturned in creating a magical atmosphere of royal wonderment at its best. Blending modern-day comforts with exceptional services makes imperial Delhi the ideal destination for business as well as leisure travelers.

Vivanta by Taj in New Delhi is designed to create a wonderful stay experience. Situated in the serene and quiet suburbs of Dwarka, this 5-star hotel offers an incredibly laid-back environment complete with elegant interiors, well-spoken and welcoming staff, and spacious rooms. The restaurants and cafes here are created to offer delectable international cuisines from across the globe right on your plate. Considered one of the best wedding venues in Delhi, Vivanta boasts several such awesome amenities that come in handy to visitors.

Pullman Delhi is all about happy vibes and good times. Located very close to the Indira Gandhi International Airport in Aerocity, Pullman Hotel is within driving distance of the hubs of both Gurgaon as well as New Delhi. Rooms in Pullman are spacious, welcoming, and warm while also showcasing modern contemporary interior styles. Some of the suites also offer stunningly scenic views of the airport runway adding an exciting touch to the stay experience. All this teamed with amenities such as complimentary WIFI and an extensive selection of award-winning restaurants and cafes makes Pullman a real crowd-puller.

Radisson is one 5-star hotel that needs no introduction. Situated just 5 minutes away from the Delhi International Airport, its connectivity to various hubs in and around the city makes it the first choice among travelers. The hotel leaves no stone unturned in ensuring safety, hygiene, and overall a great staycation for every guest walking in. When it comes to the range and quality of foods in Radisson restaurants, there is no competition. The staff offers an incredibly welcoming atmosphere while catering to every one of your needs.

If it is a modern space with a touch of eclectic vibe you are looking for, then head on to Aloft in Aerocity. The hotel represents the modern-day lifestyle of work, play, and relaxation at its best. The interiors are vibrant and colourful which will put you in a happy spirit from the moment you walk in. Guests can indulge in a top-notch dine-in experience at one of the many restaurants or check out the weekly live music sessions that help unwind and get a taste of some of the finest drinks at the finest bar.

Looking to stay in style? Hyatt Regency is just the place for you. Established in 1957, the primary goal of the hotel has always been to provide a memorable stay for everyone. Find peace away from the bustle of the national capital in the Hyatt Regency. This 5-star hotel redefines a luxurious stay. Enjoy the award-winning dining experience, innovative spa and salon service, state-of-the-art fitness center, and more incredible amenities. The exceptional hospitality and convenient connectivity to the rest of the city will be the icing on the cake.

The Lodhi Delhi is an urban oasis in the middle of the bustling city of Delhi. From the moment you walk into the Lodhi, the incredible interiors and contemporary design styles will immediately catch your attention. This place is all about representing the culture, wellness, architecture, and lifestyle at its best. Situated very close to the iconic heritage site of the Lodi Garden, this 5-star hotel boasts a world-class spa, lap pool, tennis court, fitness centers, and more. What makes it better is the well-curated selection of cafes and restaurants.

The Crowne Plaza New Delhi is situated 21 kms away from the international and domestic airports in the heart of the corporate and industrial hub of Delhi. Along with a memorable comfortable stay, the hotel also offers completely integrated hospitality for business as well as leisure travelers alike. Try out the delectable selection of Italian and Chinese cuisines at its best at the hotel restaurants. Kick back and relax with a cup of coffee at the French Heart cafe. The story doesn’t end here, offering a wide range of rejuvenating experiences in the spa and fitness center as well as the outdoor pool.

The Claridges in Delhi demonstrates the peak luxury experience at its best. Established in 1955 the Claridges has carved out a name for itself in the iconic 5-star hotels category. What makes a stay here even more worth it is the innovative collection of bars and restaurants. The inspiring designs, eclectic styles, and wonderful vibe give every guest here a comforting feeling. This 5-star hotel is unlike any other in the capital city, mainly due to its incredible blend of world-world elegance with contemporary luxury.

Over 3 decades, Le Meridien Delhi has beautifully transformed itself into a stunning masterpiece of a 5-star hotel that makes the visit of every guest memorable. This 5-star hotel represents world-class architecture, a delectable range of cuisines, impeccable design, and futuristic styles. Situated right at the heart of the city, Le Meridien stands tall as a remarkable glass building surrounded by some of the most important buildings and institutions of national importance. The shopping hubs of CP and Janpath are within walking distance from the hotel.

Showcasing a modern, contemporary style and design that appeals to the eye, the Novotel Hotel in Delhi’s Aerocity is a must-visit. With numerous dining options, cafes, and a world of epic amenities, the hotel is conveniently located adjacent to both international as well as domestic airports. Other than that the ballroom, meeting spaces, sports bar, and numerous other such facilities make Novotel rank among one of the highest-rated 5-star hotels in Delhi.

Glorifying the aristocratic heart of New Delhi, Hotel Ambassador is all about displaying the modern contemporary ways of life. Just a very short drive away from the international airport of Delhi, the Ambassador is one of the most sought-after destinations for leisure and business travel expeditions. Did you know that the ambassador has won the greenery sustainability certification for its cheerful design combined with nostalgic spaces? Along with the top-notch services and hospitable staff, its nearness to Khan Market and the Lutyens area makes a stay at Ambassador truly a royal experience.

The Connaught is situated in the heart of Lutyen’s Delhi and showcases the Luxe Blend of art deco charm with modern contemporary wonderment. Home to some of the finest city’s fine dining experiences and up-class services and amenities, the Connaught has to be one of the most eclectic hotels in New Delhi as of now. The hotel’s stand-out design and architecture representing Georgian architecture complete with appealing accents, stylings, and furnishings makes the Connaught one of a kind. Located close to the iconic CP market as well as important business centers a stay here is extremely convenient for every traveler.

Hilton Garden Inn is located in the posh Delhi locality of Saket. Located 14 km from the international airport and 5 km from Nehru Place, the hotel is studded with magnificent well-maintained rooms. Each room boasts of being equipped with ergonomic seating, comfortable bedding, complimentary WIFI service, and many more such convenient services. Guests can also enjoy a huge array of delectable dishes and drinks at the restaurants and spirits bar here. Known for its delicious selection of breakfast buffets, its proximity to the shopping hub of Saket malls, and its family-friendly environment, Hilton Garden Inn is all about bringing you a luxurious stay experience.

Shangri La Delhi is situated in one of the most happening heart of New Delhi. Its convenient location to the parliament and other central government offices as well as to the iconic heritage sites such as India Gate, Janpath, and more makes Shangri La the first choice among travelers. The uniquely modern room designs offer a brand new contemporary outlook to the whole stay experience. Guests have the option of indulging in a variety of cuisines through their amazing selection of national and international grade of cuisines. The hotel also boasts well-equipped meeting rooms and an opulent ballroom as well as an open terrace which makes the hotel a preferred choice for many.

Often defined as a cosmopolitan elegance in the heart of South Delhi, Sheraton is an iconic hotel. The red sandstone building stands out in the bustling capital offering an old-world charm to the surroundings. The ambiance of this 5-star hotel is unlike others where it attempts at creating a warm, homely feel for everyone to enjoy a home away from home vibe. Services for each guest are impeccably designed and personalized. The bespoke wellness spa, a massive range of cuisines in its award-winning restaurants, and more make Sheraton a great holiday experience.

The moment you step into the premises of the Roseate New Delhi, its visual poetry will be immediately instilled in your hearts. It is the seamless way in which its tranquil atmosphere and nature depictions bond together with the impeccable heritage-inspired modern contemporary architecture, that will leave the guests spellbound. Embodying a brand-new spectrum of hospitality, luxury, and tranquillity, a stay here will be a deeply rejuvenating experience. Stay in one of the many incredible suites, and enjoy the round-the-clock amenities. Looking for a business center? Look no further. Roseate Delhi also has well-equipped meetings and conference centers.

Radisson Blu Marina occupies the peak location in Delhi i.e. at CP. This 5-star studded hotel is all about entertainment, shopping, and fun times all brought to you in one plate. Although located in the middle of the bustling town, the interiors of the hotel work as a quiet oasis. From free WIFI services to a properly equipped fitness center and a spa therapy option this stay is all the more worthwhile. The rooms are classic yet impressively modern with all the new-age amenities. Soak up the city’s fascinating historic culture and have a deep riveting holiday in the national capital with Radisson Blu Marina.

The Pride Plaza property embraces the blend of opulence and comfort in a stylish bag. If it is a unique memorable stay that you are looking for then Pride Plaza Hotel is ready to offer you the stay experience of a lifetime. The hotel is located very close to the Delhi airport in Aerocity making accessibility easier than ever. The rooms are palatial and complete with state-of-the-art modern technology. Every inch of the hotel is dedicated to representing the beauty of India through art and architecture. The unique factor of the hotel is the fact that it sells homemade jams, pickles, etc. one can truly feel at home and welcome.

Just minutes away from the Delhi airport is a lap of refreshing greenery at the four points by Sheraton. Enhance your stay experience by booking your next stay in Delhi here. Swim in the shimmering outdoor pool, don’t miss out on your workouts at the fitness center, complete your meetings at the meeting space, and indulge in some of the lip-smacking cuisines at the many restaurants Four Points has to offer. The rooms give a Cozy, modern yet very homely vibe that will make you feel instantly relaxed upon entering. The hard-working and efficient staff and management will ease you right in.

This upscale luxury hotel is situated in the heart of West Delhi very close to the metro station. Due to its location, guests can indulge in shopping sprees, try out various types of culinary delicacies, and travel all over the national capital easily. The staff is courteous and welcoming while the rooms are super comfortable and relaxing. The rooms are also loved by everyone for their Multifunctionality feature which also celebrates the local heritage art and culture of the city. Make your stay even more rejuvenating by going for a soothing spa therapy treatment. What’s better than spending time by the pool after a long exhausting day of Delhi Darshan ?

content.text: Noida is one of the most popular NCR in New Delhi and home to over 6 lakh residents. This perfectly planned city is located within the Gautam Buddha Nagar district of UP. With over 50% green cover, Noida has been ranked as one of the greenest cities in India. With wide open spaces, skyscrapers, and highrises, Noida is quickly becoming the best location to stay, work and enjoy! While talking about the best aspects of Noida, its thumping nightlife should not be left out. Here are 19 of the best nightclubs in Noida for a happening night out:
List of 19 Best Night Clubs Near me in Noida

Situated in Logix city centre, I sacked newton is a wonderful pub for everyone. If you are looking for an evening dinner party then this place is perfect. With a huge range of choices for vegetarians as well as non-vegetarians along with a side of delicious cocktails, the vibe of this place is definitely immaculate. The decor will take you back in time and remind you of an old-time English cafe. You can sit comfortably on their stylish couches, and eat any food of your liking that can range from north Indian, continental, and Italian to street food, Thai and Mughlai selection.

Located inside one of the best malls in India, the great India place, the Ice cube is the perfect nightclub for a happening party. Due to its location, it attracts a large crowd that loves to dance to awesome music while eating some of the most delicious cuisines. The bar here is very well equipped with a mind-boggling range of cocktails. If you get tired from dancing on the lively dance floor you can sit back at the comfortable seating arrangement. Ice cube also has an outdoor seating arrangement for people who would like to sit outside and enjoy the weather with delectable foods.

Famed for being one of the most opulent nightclubs in Noida, the grand royal nightclub is a wonderful place for everyone. From college kids to corporate workers, everyone flocks to this place for its delicious meals, buzzing cocktails selection, and of course the foot-tapping music that will force you to the dance floor. The nightclub offers a massive range of cuisines ranging from North Indian to continental. The seating is spacious and airy which allows everyone to move around freely. The best part about this place is the fun-filled dance floor that will immediately draw you towards it.

Reverb is one name that tops the ranks for being one of the best nightclubs in Noida. Mostly frequented by college goers and the young crowd of Noida, reverb has successfully captured the hearts of everyone. If you are looking to welcome the weekend on a high note, then this place has no match. If you have the right budget to party then you can spend an incredibly memorable time here. Complete with indoor and outdoor seating, the bar displays a fully packed bar in every corner. Head on to reverb for a happening live music session.

Referred also as a ‘hidden gem of sector 18’, reverb club and lounge is a must visit nightclub in Noida. Are weekday blues getting you down? Head on to the blue club and lounge with your family and group of friends for a happening time. The club is very well equipped with fun things for the club goers to indulge in. If you feel like having some of the best collections of wine and cocktails for the weekend, then the blue club is the right place for you. Other than the happening dance floor, the club also gives the option of exploring your singing chops during the karaoke session.

Break the mundane routine of life at this iconic resto-pub in Noida. Situated at the famous centre stage mall in sector 18 Noida, Elevate very nicely represents what it stands for. The club is decorated perfectly and amps up the feeling of partying. With neon lights and cushy furniture, one can have the time of their life. Along with a massive range of cocktails and cuisines, elevate regularly organizes fun-filled DJ nights that will be perfect to let go of the weekday blues and welcome the weekend in full power energy. It is one of those clubs in Noida that will work perfectly in rejuvenating you.

Club 44 is the perfect nightclub for everyone who is a foodie and loves grooving to vibey music. The setting here is rather whimsical with the presence of both outdoor and indoor seating and couches for 2 to 6 people. The lighting will make you feel like you are in a movie. The dance floor is perfectly lit and invites even non dancers to dance till the break of dawn. The staff is very polite and gentle which is like an icing on the cake. Situated close to Amity University, the club is a favourite among college kids and young crowd.

Club Tito’s is all about good times, good vibes, and impeccable food. The flamboyant decor and the vibey energy is probably the first thing that you will notice while entering the club. The club is a happening spot throughout the week but it literally springs to life, light, colour and music during the weekend. The huge lounging area is where you can chill out if you get tired from dancing on the large dance floor. The combination of delectable food and fun time are the perfect contents for a memorable night out. Groove to party music all night long at this party destination of Noida.

Are you planning for a party? Some get-together? Or just a nightclub to dance till your feet hurt? Make your way to the Chicane club and lounge and a great time is guaranteed. Located in spice world mall, this luxurious and classy club is the peak attraction for regular clubbers and people who love to party and have a good time. From enjoying sporting events at the flat screen displays here or enjoying the electrifying live performances, this club will keep you entertained throughout! The venue also hosts several corporate and private parties which goes perfectly with the on-point lighting arrangement and comfortable seating.

Looking for a fun time with the gang? Head on to the LIT ultra-bar club and lounge. LIT stands true to its name where the food is delicious, the music is thumping and there are many opportunities to have a memorable time. Take a seat in one of the comfiest seating and couches along with an amazing beer tower and their headlining delicious platter of different types. Situated in Noida sector 18, LIT boasts of an incredible selection of cocktails and alcohol. The lighting here creates an undeniable vibe of happiness and joy. From indoor seating to living sports screening and regular happy hours, LIT will definitely leave you coming back for more.

You may have heard of the stock exchange but have you heard of the brand new concept of pub exchange? If not then you definitely need to head over to Noida pub exchange. Although there is no dedicated dance floor here, the club is spread over a very large and spacious area where you can dance near your designated tables. The casual setup will take the edge off after a long day of working and being busy. The chill vibes, good music and multi-cuisine menu will make for a night out well spent.

Situated in gardens galleria, Time machine is all about posh, classy, and elegance with a hint of fun background music. It can be your one-stop for a fun clubbing experience. The decor at the time machine is like no other. It seems like it will take you back in time. Due to its location in the heart of the city and a wonderful mall, it draws a huge clientele. Time machine makes sure to give a good time to everyone visiting through their impeccable, polite, and humble staff. A visit here will prove to be the perfect choice for a delightful night out with your friends or family.

Barrack 62 has to be one of the quirkiest themed gastro pubs in Noida. From the moment you step inside the club, you will be pleasantly surprised with its decor, lighting, and overall vibes. What makes this club more special than others is the fact that the makers stayed true to the ‘barrack’ theme. This theme is also very cleverly implemented even in the smallest aspects. For example, the bill here is referred to as ‘Jamaanat’. You can go there for a chill time or party like never before. It has both the vibes perfectly balanced. Pick your favorite food from the extensive menu or choose your favorite cocktail, no matter what you do a memorable and fun time is guaranteed.

Imperfecto is one name that is synonymous with happening parties and a good time overall. Gorge on delicious North Indian, Italian and fast food while also savouring some of the best alcohol collection in Noida. Situated in Logix city centre, imperfecto will definitely lighten up your mood. It is the perfect spot for college kids and young people to sit back and relax while also having the time of their lives. What makes the whole experience truly memorable is the humble staff that tends to every need and whim of their guests. The foods are colourful, setup is spectacular and very personalized and the music goes on throughout the day that will not let you sit in peace.

Located in DLF mall of India, the Irish house is another one of the most loved theme clubs in Noida. Offering a range of finger foods, European and American cuisines, and the Irish house is truly one of a kind. The seating is smart casual which invokes a feeling of comfort and luxury at the same time. The place is truly unique because there are limited American and European-themed clubs in not just Noida but in Delhi as well. Try out their specialties like drunken prawns, sweet potato fries, and mushroom bites among a host of other options. As the sun sets, the entire place turns into a happening and a thumping club.

The turquoise cottage is a very famous chain of pubs that has garnered immense popularity among the regulars of Delhi’s club scene. Turquoise cottage Noida is all about good food, delicious cocktails, and a posh, happening crowd. You can chill in the outside seating area or sit back and relax in the indoor seating. The food is made with extreme care with the usage of good quality herbs and spices. The vibe here is extremely posh and the seating arrangement, as well as the lighting, makes it the perfect place for every party goer to have a fun-filled time.

Zest bar and lounge are all about offering a good time. Known for its captivating sports screening and a happening ambiance, zest is a great place to go to with your friends. Situated in sector 18 Noida, the place is mainly famous for its interesting lighting and exciting vibe, especially during some sporting events. The place is amazing, especially its happening music selection. It is overall a very good place to just chill out, even during the weekdays. The IT factor here is the awesome live DJ playing that will motivate you to leave your seats and dance.

With pretty lighting, wooden interiors and abstract art adorning the walls leaves a very good first impression on the guests. This popular resto-bar in Noida hosts live screening sessions with live musical performances. If you are looking for the right place to spend a fun-packed, memorable evening with your loved one or buddy group then the smoke factory is a perfect choice. The party ambiance here is palpable and from the moment you step in, you will feel like dancing right away. Weekend at the smoke factory is a whole other ball game. The house DJ stirs up the whole crowd through his amazing song selection.

When it comes to an old reliable name, the RPM Zanzi Bar will never disappoint you. From hosting corporate parties to having a fun time with your group of friends, you can party it all up till the break of dawn. The massive collection of wines at RPM sets it apart from its contemporaries. Get the best of the cheapest Turkish and French wine, if you wish to go wine tasting for a change. Other than that, the entire bar is a treat for everyone. This rustic hideaway boasts of delicious foods, good food, and an overall memorable time. The bar is large and can cater to a large group of people.

content.text: Rai Parveen Mahal is one of the most attractive tourist locations located in Orchha of Madhya Pradesh . It was built by Maharaja Indrajit Singh in 1618 for his favourite courtesan Rai Parveen. This palace in built in exquisite Mughal architecture and the intricate work of the palace is worth appreciating. The palace has a main hall, terraces and chambers which are filled with air and light which offers a soothing and calming experience.

According to historical sources Rai Parveen was a very beautiful and multi-talented woman who was a singer, dancer and a great poetess. Some of her belongings are still kept in the palace. She was the favourite mistress of Raja Indramani (1672 – 75) during the time of Aurangzeb. The palace is octagonal in shape and has a Mughal garden outside which add more beauty to the palace.

Rai Parveen was a famous for her enchanting beauty and her poetic skills. She was also a very good musician and dancer. She was the favourite mistress of Indrajit Singh. Her beauty and charm was so popular that she was well known far and wide and her popularity finally reached the court of Akbar.

Akbar was smitten by her beauty and ordered that she be sent to his court. Indrajit Singh was too weak to defy the order of the powerful Mughal emperor and finally had to send her to his durbar. However when she reached the Durbar she recited a couplet which highly impressed Akbar who then rewarded her and allowed her to return to Orchha. This palace is three storied and is made up of brick and lies to the north of Sheesh Mahal. In the second story of this palace there are different sculptures depicting various Indian dance poses. Since Rai Parveen was a famous dancer this palace has many dance and music halls meant for dance shows.

There are also lawns, underground apartments, and small temples inside the palace. On the second story the walls of the central hall is filled with many paintings that depict the many moods of Rai Parveen. The garden in the palace is known as the Anand Mahal bag.

Orchha is a very beautiful town in Madhya Pradesh which is famous for its attractive and exquisite archaeological monuments. Located on the banks of river Betwa, this town was founded by Maharaja Rudra Pratap Singh in the year 1501.

The name of the town means a hidden place and it is richly covered with natural beauty and serene vegetation. The marvelous monuments scattered all over the town gives it its unique charm and importance.

It has the ancient temples built in the 16th and 17th century. Some of the important tourist attractions in this town are the Jahangir Mahal, Raj Mahal, Ram Raja Temple, Phool Bagh and Lakshmi Narayan temple. It is also known for its world-class Mural Paintings which are found on the walls of the temple and palaces.

content.text: The train reaches Thanjavur in the hour before sunrise. It’s the hour of the Gods. The very air seems to resonate with the sounds of worship, even as great flocks of birds call to each other as they fly across the rich, riverine delta known as the rice bowl of Tamil Nadu .

This is the land that was once home to the magnificent Chola Temples dynasty. In the early years of the 10th century A.D., under the patronage of the Chola emperor Raja Raja Chola I the Great (985-1014), it was an empire that shone like the Sun itself, rising in the East and spreading its rays in every direction. From its ports, great argosies of ships left for other parts of South Asia, taking with them ideas of kingship based on cultural and religious themes that found their manifestation in architectural marvels carved out of stone, taking different forms in their new homes.

This is what makes the grand Chola Temples that Raja Raja Chola I built at Thanjavur such a piece of living history. It’s a compendium of all the arts of sculpture, painting, architecture, as well as the allied ones of music, dance, jewelry, textiles, and bronze casting for the making of idols and temple vessels. There used to be a thousand or more temple dancers who regularly performed the daily ritual of worship at the Brihadeshwara Temple of Thanjavur in its heyday. It’s also an engineering marvel of its time. Of course, today, we tend not to notice the imposing height and enormous capstone that crowns Raja Raja’s edifice or mountain of dressed and carved stone, because verticality or gravity-defying buildings are no longer an issue. What’s striking is the exquisite attention to detail. You stare into the dark niches that surround the inner walls of the temple and come face to face with marvelous bronze statues.

Many of these have been relocated to the Thanjavur Art Gallery attached to the Thanjavur Palace. You climb into the inner corridors that have been created around the base of the main tower and come upon magnificent wall paintings that illuminate the glory of the King-Emperor or explain episodes in the lives of the Gods and Goddesses who live in the temple. There are other corridors in which the varieties of dance poses and their mudras (hand gestures) are enumerated, perhaps for a quick reference by the celebrated temple dancers. In those still, dark spaces illuminated with a mere torch, with the scent of camphor, sandalwood oil, and jasmine seeping through the crevices of the main sanctum, you can almost feel the presence of Raja Raja Chola himself. He was just one among a great family of builders. He set the trend amongst his immediate family, so that there are tributes in stone built by and for personalities like Sembiyan Mahadevi, the wife of his grand-uncle Gandaraditya Chola, that entices the visitor with their languid grace and immense beauty.

Those who are fortunate enough to follow in the trail of the Cholas, after visiting the Temple of Brihadeshwara, take the road to Gangaikonda Cholapuram. The name signifies that Raja Raja Chola’s son, Rajendra Chola I (1012-1044), a great conqueror and strategist, had marched his troops all the way up to the Ganges and brought the sacred water down to his capital in the Trichy district – creating his own version of a Shiva temple that is also called Brihadeshwara. It’s not quite as grand as the first, but the enormous figures carved in their separate niches, some of which are said to represent the king venturing into other lands with his armies, are still impressive.

His influence can be traced to Sri Lanka , Burma, Cambodia, Thailand, and the kingdom of Srivijaya in what are now parts of the Malaysian peninsula and some of the major islands that make up Indonesia. The smaller, but still exquisite, temple at Darasuram, built by Raja Raja Chola II (1146-1173), is full of finely carved pieces of sculpture in polished black stone, which forms a striking contrast to the granite of the niches surrounding the main structure. The main porch incorporates the suggestion of a chariot pulling the temple forward, much like the style of the Konark Sun Temple.

The contact with these different cultures meant a great flowering of ideas between the rulers of the Chola Empire and their distant neighbors. It lingers in the most tantalizing of ways in the telling of legends that speak of merchants and princes being shipwrecked in strange lands only to be rescued by princesses described as belonging to exotic tribes, quite often referred to as Nagas, or in textile traditions that have survived through the centuries in certain motifs and weaves. More dramatically, it can be seen in the temples still standing, carved with dreaming spires enclosing any number of different gods and their representatives, the God-kings on earth.
At such moments, it seems as if the golden age of Raja Raja Chola I continues to spread its radiance.

content.text: Popularly known as the ‘queen of hill stations’ and located, at a distance of 86 kms from Coimbatore, Ooty is a refreshing hamlet, for people, wanting to get away, from the hustle and bustle of the busy city life. Offering lush green glimpses of the surrounding beauty and replete with unparalleled raw natural beauty Ooty has always been a center for tourist activities. The plunging green valleys, clean environment and the unpolluted air are what makes Ooty one of the most lovable destinations for all sorts of travellers.

Ooty the “Queen of hill stations” is also known as Udhagamandalam or Udhagai. During the Colonial time it was the favorite place for the British to spend their summer and weekend holidays. The supercilious mountains, impenetrable forest, extensive grasslands and miles and miles of tea gardens welcome the tourists. The main attraction of Ooty is its annual Tea and Tourism Festival. Located in the Nilgiri Ranges, Ooty is the perfect location for honeymoon or family vacations. So for your Honeymoon opt for Ooty honeymoon package or for your family vacation opt for Ooty packages.

In your Ooty tourism packages you must have to include Government Rose Garden, Ooty Lake, Ooty Botanical Gardens, Toda huts, Stone House, Ooty Mountain Railway, St. Stephen’s Church, Ooty Golf Course, Wax World, and Tribal Museum. There are innumerable tourist spots around Ooty which you must add in your Ooty tour like Doddabetta Peak, Pykara, Wenlock Downs, Pine forest, Mudumalai National Park, Upper Bhavani, Emerald and Avalanche Lake and many more. In Ooty you must go for bird watching, boating in Ooty Lake and Pykara Lake, experiencing sunset in Doddabetta peak, trekking, and hiking in Nilgiri Mountain range.

The highest peak in the Hills of the Nilgiris (2,623 metres), this place falls right at the crossroads of the Eastern and the Western Ghats. This place should definitely be included on your visit to Ooty since this will be a refreshing experience. Situated at a mere distance of almost 10 kms from the main town of Ooty, this place offers breathtaking views of the panoramic surrounding. There is also a Telescope House which is maintained by the Tamil Nadu Tourism Development Corporation and also enables the tourists to get a better view.

Ooty botanical garden attracts tourists from all over the world. Flourishing, green, well-maintained lawns, rare species of trees, a 20 million-year-old fossil tree, an Italian – style garden bordering, a variety of flowers, a range of ferns and orchids along with the presence of a crystal clear pool are some of the attraction points for this garden. The “Summer Festival” held each year at the Botanical Garden during the month of May is again popular. The pride of the festival still remains a colorful and vibrant slower show.

The Pykara River is famed for being the largest river in the Nilgiris District. It gushes down majestically in a series of cascades and the last two gushes down the remaining 55 meters and 61 meters forming the Pykara falls. The boating here is a lot of fun, so do try it if you are in Ooty. Wenlock Downs is a vast expanse of grassy meadows on way to Pykara, is very popular with the movie makers in the country.

Rose Park is situated in the heart of Ooty less than a km from Charring Cross at Vizianagaram. The garden has the largest collections of roses in the country (around 3000 varieties) which includes Hybrid Tea Roses, miniature rose, Floribunda, Ramblers, etc. It has also received the certificate of being a “Garden of Excellence” by the World Federation of Rose Societies (WFRS) in 2006.
The immaculate St Stephen’s Church, was constructed in 1829, and is the oldest church in the Nilgiris, with lovely stained glass.

Located on the slopes of Kalhatty, these cascading falls are about 100 feet high and located at a distance of about 13kms from Ooty. There are several wild species like panthers, Sambhar, bison and wild buffaloes endemic to this region.

Avalanche Dam and Lake is located at a distance of 25 km from Ooty. Trekking is quite popular here. The nearby trout farm is the only place in India where trout fish grow. The lake is ideal for fishing and bird watching.

Located at a distance of about 67kms from the wonderful hilly hamlet of Ooty, this Wildlife sanctuary is rich and filled with a varied collection of flora and fauna. It is also home to innumerable rare species of birds and animals. You can also easily get a glimpse of animals like elephants, giant squirrels, Sambhar, chital, barking deer and flying squirrels and birds including colorful parakeets, black woodpecker, Malabar trogon and crested hawk eagle.

Located at a comfortable distance of 17 kms from Ooty, the famous hill station of Coonoor stands at an elevation of 1839 meters above sea level. In upper Coonoor lies Sim’s Park, which houses more than 1000 plant species, including many flowering plants, pines, ferns and shrubs.
When in Ooty, you must try the city’s famous buns, Varkis, cakes, and other baked items, as well as fruit and nut chocolates available in most stores.

The weather of Ooty is generally pleasant all year round and it can be visited any time of the year. The most suitable period to visit the hill station are the months of February, March, October and November. While summers are charming and colorful, the winters in Ooty are relatively colder compared to other parts of South India. During the summers the temperature ranges from 10 to 25 degrees, while during the winters it ranges between 5 and 21 degrees centigrade.

Hotel Kluney Manor is a heritage property which provides wonderful accommodation at an affordable rate. The hotel is 165-year-old property which beautifully combines old-world charm with modern facilities to make the stay of its guests comfortable and memorable. Sprawling across 2 acres, it was renovated a few years back. All the guestrooms are elegantly done up offering plenty of comforts. The on-site restaurant serves delicious food in the soothing ambiance. From Indian to Chinese and Continental, all kinds of dishes are served. For the convenience of the guests railway and airport transfer is also provided. There is also a coffee shop where you can spend some quality time with your friends or family.

Inn Gem Park is a modern hotel with a traditional touch. It is set in the heart of the city, overlooking the arresting valley and close to the tourist attractions and major shopping areas. Offering best of facilities and services, the hotel is ideal for both holiday makers as well as business travelers. The fabulous lobby features arresting Indian art and the entire hotel has an ambiance that spells grandeur and majesty. It features 95 rooms and suites which are beautifully decorated and loaded with modern amenities. The two on-site restaurants serve mouth-watering culinary delights and the bar offers a variety of drinks.

content.text: The Maldives is a perfect destination for those who love Scuba diving and want to have an amazing experience of diving into the water and want to see the world of underwater species. The boat charters of Maldives are having the capacity to bear the weight of 10-20 passengers together. The boats are equipped with everything you need for life on board and are accompanied by a second boat, known as a Dhoni – a traditional Maldives dive boat – on which all the scuba diving equipment is stored and from where all dives begin. Having this second boat is a great advantage because it can navigate much shallower waters and get much closer to the dive sites than the actual liveaboard boat.

The best thing about holidaying on a safari boat in the Maldives is that it allows you to explore far more of the country and its magnificent dive sites than you would be able to if scuba diving from a resort dive centre. Because the Maldives islands cover such a large expanse of ocean, if you were tied to sleeping in one place, and had to return there every night by boat, the amount of time you would be able to spend actually scuba diving would be far more limited and the experience would likely be much more expensive. Maldives boat trip dive trips on a liveaboard tend to be surprisingly affordable, especially if you are not opting for one of the more high-end liveaboard boats.

There is an incredible variety of Maldives safari boats on offer when looking to book your Maldives diving holiday, and you will find one to suit every taste and budget. Possibly the most exciting liveaboard dive boat in the Maldives is Theia.

Theia is a brand new dive safari boat in the Maldives that was launched in 2010 and has been causing a lot of excitement. Offering stylish travel, Theia has accommodation for up to 16 people through 6 cabins and 2 suites, each with en-suite, hot water bathrooms and a stylish Asian décor. The suites located on the upper deck go that one step further, as they are equipped with flat-screen televisions and private balconies, giving guests a touch more privacy.

Other destinations for a sophisticated Maldives boat holiday are the liveaboards Island Safari 2 Royal, Dream Catcher II and MV Orion. Just like Theia, MV Orion was first launched in 2010 and is reminiscent of the private Superyachts seen cruising the Caribbean or Mediterranean. Described by one diver as “business class scuba diving”, the 130-feet MV Orion houses special features including a private outdoor Jacuzzi on the deck of the master suite, stunning lounge areas and immaculate interior design throughout.

Naturally, dive holidays aboard MV Orion, Theia, Dream Catcher II and Island Safari 2 Royal come at a premium, with a night’s accommodation costing around USD $200 on each of the boats, which includes all meals and dives. Now, if you compare this with the price of accommodation in one of the Maldives’ most luxurious resorts and then factor in the cost of diving from a resort dive centre, you will actually find that luxury Maldives boat diving is surprisingly affordable.

Furthermore, Maldives diving holidays can be even more economical if you choose one of the many other boats on offer. There is a wide range of Maldivian boats that offer liveaboard diving holidays at a more competitive price, from as little as USD $165 per night. Some of the best choices in this price range include Stingray, Black Pearl and Nautilus One and Nautilus Two. All of these offer a variety of cruises throughout the year which include all dives, meals and accommodation.

If you’re looking for more of a feeling of adventure on your diving holidays in the Maldives and have a minimum of 60 dives in your logbook, Nautilus Two is a great option. This traditional Maldivian-style vessel is kitted out with everything you could need for a comfortable diving adventure. The boat is constructed completely out of wood and has 12 cabins – each air-conditioned and with a private bathroom. Nautilus Two also features an outdoor Jacuzzi on one of the decks for use by all the guests and hammocks are strung out in the shade for whiling away your surface intervals in peace.

Now you know there are plenty of Maldives liveaboard dive boats to choose from, there are a few more snippets of information you’ll need to know before you’re ready to start finding the right boat for you and looking into booking some Maldives boat trips. It’s important to understand that the prices for liveaboard holidays do not include flights from your home country to the Maldives, but do tend to include transfers from the airport to the Maldives holiday boat. Likewise, while the boats are typically equipped with a complete bar, alcoholic drinks are not included in the packages and so are charged separately at the end of your trip.

As most experienced scuba divers tend to have their own scuba equipment and prefer not to hire, the prices do not include scuba equipment rental, although this can easily be organized at the time of reserving your Maldives boat safari. Some of the Maldives safari boat operators offer scuba certification courses if you are not yet a certified diver, while others will require that you are already a certified diver. Be sure to indicate your experience level when arranging your Maldives boat holiday. It’s also good to bear in mind that the Maldives is home to some strong currents and some of the dives are in deep water, so it’s really an ideal destination for an advanced diver, although that’s not to say there are no dive spots suitable for beginners.

content.text: It is a cup-shaped valley called, “The Meadow of Flowers”. It is the finest and the most famous pleasure resorts in Kashmir. It is a lush green meadow sprinkled with flowers, a height of 2,650 meters above the sea level. It is at a distance of about 46 kms from Srinagar. The en route stations are Shalteng (7 kms); Mirgund (13 kms); Magam (23 kms); Tangmarg (38 kms) and Gulmarg (46 kms).

The alpine valley of Gulmarg has an undulating topography which adds to its scenic beauty and majestic charm. All the basic amenities i.e., hotels, market, boarding houses and transport etc. of a hill station are available at Gulmarg. The weather is delightfully cool even during the summer seasons, with intermittent showers of train, which far exceeds that of the valley. The green-carpeted meadows offer a beautiful view to the tourists and a perfect level of slopes to the golfers.
In Gulmarg, there is also a 500-meter chairlift. A cable car project (Gondola) highest in the world is operating from this scenic spot.
Gulmarg receives snowfall periodically from November to April, often above 15 feet and mostly gets the first and last snowfall in the valley.

Gulmarg is a perennial scenic spot. The international golf course, at Gulmarg, is known for its green grass’ rolling gentle slopes and towering heights. The Golf Club was established in 1902 it is the highest golf course in the world. In winter, Gulmarg is the Playground for skiing. Gulmarg provides an excellent base for undertaking some of the most delightful treks. The Gulmarg Gondola Cable Car, the highest in the World connects Gulmarg with Kongdori and Apharwat (4080m) a famous ridge that offer breathtaking view of the area throughout the year.
St. Mary’s Church atop a meadow built in 1902 A.D., Rani Temple and the Maharaja Palace are worth seen. A newly developed lake and a children’s park is quite fascinating.
Around the Gulmarg
The various locations around the Gulmarg are:
Outer Circular Walk

This seven Kms, circular road, girdles Gulmarg through pine forests. Once can have a panoramic view of the valley; the massifs of Nanga Parbat and Harmukh; and the rugged slopes of Ferozepur; sunset peaks and Apharwat ridge.
Khilanmarg

A green meadow carpeted with wild flowers, is just 5 kms from Gulmarg, towards the western side. It is at the height of 3460 meters, carpeted with wild flowers. It is referred as a “Paradise for Botanist”. It affords a glorious view of the valley and its surrounding mountain ranges, which include the Naga Parbat.
Alpather Lake

This triangular lake with floating ice, and connected with small tarns in its neighbourhood, is in the close vicinity of Apharwat Mountain. From Khilanmarg the lake is about 8 kms in distance and one can reach by foot or by the pony ride. The catchment area of the lake is full of snow round the year. It is at the height of 3843 meters.
Baba Reshi Shrine
It is a shrine of noted Saint Baba Payam Rishi, about 8 kms from Gulmarg where devotees from all parts of Kashmir are seen throughout the year.
Tangmarg
It is a famous stopover en route Gulmarg. A short trekking route from Tangmarg to Gulmarg is very exciting.
Tosh Maidan
It is one of the most beautiful parts of the valley of Kashmir, that can be reached from Gulmarg via Ferozepur Nallah.

content.text: Khajuraho, the famous temple town of Madhya Pradesh pulls tourists not only from different corners of the nation but from different corners of the globe as well. The Khajuraho temple is a rare artistic and architectural masterpiece and has been awarded the title of ‘world heritage site’. The erotic sculptures on the temple show an artist’s creative frenzy and wild passion at full play. If you wish to enjoy this marvel, you must embark on a tour to Khajuraho at least once. This travel information guide below will provide you all the necessary info.

Khajuraho retains a special glory amongst the best known World heritage sites of India. The temples of Khajuraho are amongst the most stunning historical monuments of India. It’s estimated that these temples were all built by the Chandela rulers between the periods 900 AD to 1130. The Chandela Rulers were earlier known as Bargujar Rajputs who were Shiva worshipers. Khajuraho was the capital of Chandel kingdom and it remained the cultural capital even after Mahoba was appointed as capital later. This period was the epitome of the Chandela rule and each ruler had at least one temple to his credit. Broadly speaking, temple building was a custom amongst the Chandela rulers and almost all other rulers of the Chandela Clan.

The first temple of Khajuraho is believed to have been built (according to literary accounts by Abu Rehan al Beruni in AD 1022 and the Arab Scholar Ibn Battuta) around 1000 AD. Khajuraho town was the religious capital of Khajuraho. There was a huge wall with 8 inbuilt gates surrounding Khajuraho and each gate was flanked by two fully grown date trees. It was because of the date (Khajur) trees that the place got its name as Khajur Vahika. Alternatively Khajuraho was also known as Jejakabhukti.

After the Chandela dynasty fell from power post 1150 the temples of Khajuraho were disfigured badly by Muslim invaders and they suffered destruction. Local people were forced to leave Khajuraho because of the ruthless attack of Muslims. Historical lore says that the local townsfolk decided that if they left the town then invaders would spare the sanctity of the temples. Thus from the 13th century to 18th century the temples of Khajuraho remained under dense forest cover shielded away from eyes of the world before being discovered by British Engineer T.S Burt.

Temples of Khajuraho have prominent posters in the Tourist Office of India and they have also been depicted in the temple grounds. Many famous dancers and musicians have given recitals with the famous Khajuraho temples in the background. However Khajuraho has mostly claimed the limelight because of the constructs of sexuality that feature in the temple architecture. The sheer fluidity of the lines and the eroticism of the figures have been referred to as an example of the liberal attitude of India. Gays and Lesbians have often cited Khajuraho as the epitome of expressions of sexual freedom.

Some scholars opine that the erotic statues of Khajuraho are often interpreted as sexual intercourse positions between divine beings, gods and goddesses. The temples that have such carvings and sculptures stand at some distance from the cluster of Jain temples and Hindu temples. The outer wall sculptures demonstrate the life style of common members of the society during the medieval age.

10th Century famous poetic and literary work like Karpuramanjari, Kavyamimansa, Prabodhacandrodaya etc are represented thematically in the sculptures of Khajuraho. Other interesting iconography includes Vrik Vyala (fusion of lion and wolf) and Gaja Vyala (fusion of lion and elephant). The stories about temple architecture abound in the small town of Khajuraho and are expressed by locals through their art and craft.

Khajuraho is a town steeped in rich history and culture and fabric of social life here is fascinating. The population of Khajuraho is not high and the economy of the town is dependent on the tourism activities that center on monuments and temples of Khajuraho. The local folks here still follow the village lifestyle and are deeply religious.
Locals speak Hindi and many of them know rudimentary English. The local guides and some hotel staff speak Dutch, French and Jewish too.
The temples of Khajuraho are well known for their architectural splendor. There are more than a hundred temples in the town and these are divided into separate blocks.
This is the largest and the most famous temple group in Khajuraho. You have to get a ticket worth INR 10 to enter this group of temples. The prominent members of Western Group of Temples are:
The Eastern Group of Khajuraho temples has more than 20 temples in their group; the most famous amongst them are mentioned below.
Other attractions near Khajuraho are the Ken River, Panna National Park and the Bandhavgarh National Park.

When in Khajuraho you can entertain yourself by walking amidst the cultural cornucopia of the town. Every lane and street in Khajuraho is teeming with stories about its glorious past. Interact with the locals there and know about their lifestyle and arts and crafts. Intellectual gatherings are frequently organized in Khajuraho here views about eroticism and spirituality are exchanged.
Arhanta Yoga Ashram in Khajuraho offers the opportunity of studying Classical Hatha Yoga in a typical Ashram setting. Many foreigners frequent this Ashrama to know more about Yoga and its benefits.

Annual Dance Festival of Khajuraho is held between 1st Feb to 7TH Feb. Lots of famous dancers and musicians showcase their skills against the stunning backdrop of the Khajuraho Western Group of Temples. The Dance Festival promises the experience of a lifetime and you shouldn’t miss seeing it if you happen to be around Khajuraho then.

This happens every evening at the Western Temple Group. The Narration is recorded in the voice of Bollywood Icon Amitabh Bachchan and there is a stunning show of light and sound which showcases the beauty of Khajuraho. The entry ticket for Indian Nationals cost 120 INR only.

Shopping for arts and crafts should definitely be a part of your agenda when you are in Khajuraho. Iron ware, stone sculptures, Brass ware etc depicting the erotic Kama sutra poses is famous in Khajuraho and you can buy them at the handicraft stores dotting the city.
The Government operated Crafts Emporium offers great deals in silver and gold ornaments, statues made of sand stone and local crafts work. The emporium is situated in Hotel Gem Palace in Jain Road.
The weekly haat at Raj nagar which is at distance of 4 km from Khajuraho is also a good place to pick up traditional silverware and brass ware.

A visit to Khajuraho will provide you with a golden opportunity to sample the delicious Madhya Pradesh cuisine . Sweets and Namkeen found in this area are quite famous and don’t forget to try out Moong dal Halwa, Kaju Barfi, jalebi and Shikanji found here. Some restaurants you can try out are:

There are many types of accommodation options in Khajuraho starting from Expensive premium hotels to Tourism Board Hotels and Budget Hotels and Lodges. You can choose your suitable option from the list given below.

Khajuraho has extreme climate with a lot of variation between day and night temperatures. Rainfall is low (114 cm annual) and the humidity is also low. In summers the temperature shoots up to around 45 degrees and winters stay pleasant at around 22-27 degrees. Feb- March is a good time to visit Khajuraho as the weather is nice and the dance festival also takes place around this time.
Flight: Khajuraho Airport is located 5 km away from the Khajuraho town and there are regular flights operated by Air India and kingfisher from Delhi and Varanasi.

Train: A train station became operational in Khajuraho and it falls on the Delhi/ Bengaluru/ Trivandrum Main Line. Strangely train tickets cannot be brought from the station and have to be booked online or from the bus station. Sampark Kranti Express and Dakshin Express are two trains that stop at Khajuraho.
Alternatively you can take a train to Satna (Allahabad-Mumbai route) or the Mahoba (Jhansi-Varanasi route).
Taxi and Bus service to Khajuraho is very good though the condition of roads is not good. Buses are available from Agra, Satna, Mahoba, Jhansi, Khajuraho and Gwalior.

content.text: Travelers insurance is a service that has been around for several decades helping those that venture away from home recover lost money, items, un-used services, and unexpected medical expenses. Most travel insurance companies cover customers that take routine or otherwise uneventful trips however for those that plan to do something potentially dangerous while on vacation, this coverage may not be adequate. It is not uncommon for people on holiday to take a trip specifically for participating in sports or other activities that are inherently dangerous such as skiing snowboarding or mountain climbing. Providers have evolved to the point today where they offer specific coverage packages to individuals planning to participate in events more dangerous than they would otherwise encounter on a typical getaway for relaxation.

Simply typing winter sports travel insurance into a search engine and choosing from the list of sites found is not the best way to approach buying insurance. For those who use or have purchased travel insurance before, it is common knowledge that there are many companies out there that do not have your best interest at heart and may be selling insurance that doesn’t cover anything at all. This article aims to provide the potential traveler with tips for avoiding the purchase of policies that will not help you in the event you need them because something is covered as well as outright misleading attempts to get you to buy.

Trusting a well-known company has led to many people buying policies that aren’t intended to be used how the company says they are. Travelers that are offered insurance when planning a trip are sometimes offered insurance to cover unexpected events like canceled trips, missed departures and a variety of other things. Because they are buying from a company that is well known or that they already have a relationship with it is easier to simply trust what a travel agent says will happen. The truth is that sometimes agents don’t even know themselves what they are selling because they haven’t read a contract personally. Insurance companies may market their plan under the term “protection” plan, which is completely different than an insurance plan according to state regulators.

In layman’s terms, this may sound like a similar thing but in the eyes of a state or state laws, this can mean the difference between the company paying out and not. Travel agents may have knowledge of this or they may not, however, your best bet is to not trust their word and read a contract yourself before signing or paying. If the terms in the contract say protection and not insurance or you see something else that raises your suspicions, don’t do it.

There are other ways to check into winter sports travel insurance providers before you even ask an agent about a policy. Reputable travel insurance companies are supported by underwriters that are heavily regulated by the state in which they operate. Underwriters are also rated by an international rating agency called A.M. Best. Potential customers can visit the agencies website at www.ambest.com to see if the company they are planning to buy from is rated or has a poor rating. If the company isn’t even listed there, it is wise not to buy. Ratings are updated annually and in some cases bi-annually.

Buying online is another way that you could be potentially scammed. Not all insurance companies that sell online are scams however, the way in which you encounter an offer for insurance online can be an indicator that the company is not reputable. For example, many people utilize online booking services like Orbitz or Hotels.com to organize and plan trips. Insurance ads may promote on these sites and entice users with easy sign-up options and hidden terms in order to get them to sign up.

No matter where you end up purchasing travel insurance, including winter sports you need to read the policy to ensure you are getting what you pay for. It is easy to be enticed by offers of cheap winter sports travel insurance and avoid reading over thousands of words in policy however a little diligence now could save you from wasting hundreds of dollars on a policy that cannot be used. If you cannot understand the language in the policy, many companies have customer service lines that can help answer questions. Language should be pretty straight forward and if the policy appears confusing then it was probably meant to be written that way and should not be agreed to.

It has often been said about many things in life that you just can’t win them all. Insurance policies are no exception and companies cannot be expected to cover you for any potential problem that arises. There are some instances that you should watch for when reading your policy that can easily be overlooked. One is for pre-existing medical conditions, which many companies will not cover however, some do. For example, if you plan to use travel insurance for winter sports and you have a heart condition that makes you faint after too much strenuous activity, a company may not cover any hospital bills incurred on the trip because of this condition. It is not to say that insurers will not cover you if you have a pre-existing condition however be sure it is included in the policy.

Don’t be afraid to shop for insurance knowing what you now know about this industry, as there are many reputable companies out there that will do what they say they will do in the event you need them to. One particular company that can be looked into is www.tripinsurancestore.com, which acts as an intermediary between customers and reputable insurance companies. Checking out ratings at A.M. Best is also a good way to find an insurer that will treat you right. No matter where you go through be sure and read your contract before you sign, ensure that the company will cover unexpected events that may be relevant to you or your trip and avoid buying insurance online unless terms and conditions, as well as policy language, are readily available from the site or a customer service number is provided.

content.text: Maharashtra , the state rich in cultural heritage and holding immense spiritual significance, is home to 5 Jyotirlingas. These sacred shrines dedicated to Lord Shiva attract millions of spiritual seekers every year. Have you ever been there? If not, but planning a tour to Jyotirlingas in Maharashtra, then you are at the very right place.

This comprehensive guide provides detailed information about the Maharashtra Jyotirlinga tour 2026 . This guide will provide a list of the Jyotirlingas in Maharashtra, their history, the best time to visit, and travel tips. Read this blog to the last, as it helps you plan an unforgettable spiritual journey efficiently.

A Jyotirlinga symbolizes the self-existence of lord Shiva in the shape of a mighty column of unlimited light. As Hindu scriptures state, he appeared in the form of a glowing column of divine fire in a total of twelve locations on the planet. These were referred to as the twelve Jyotirlingas.

The five Jyotirlingas of Maharashtra are not only a place of worship to be visited but also a cultural hub. All temples reveal years of worship and customs and practices that have been shared across generations. The visit of these shrines allows individuals to view the rich cultural heritage of Maharashtra, both in its temple art, folk stories, and ancient literature. The Panch Jyotirlinga Yatra is regarded as a purification process for the soul and attracts individuals wanting to be blessed, seek tranquility, and get rid of negative thoughts.
These temples combine to make a significant part of the Maharashtra Jyotirlinga Tour Circuit, which is very popular among religious followers and tourists.

Bhimashankar Jyotirlinga is a place venerated as the origin of the River Bhima, situated in the fertile Sahyadri ranges. This majestic pilgrimage offers a combination of harmony with spirituality and nature, with thick forests and abundant wildlife.
Key Highlights
Best Time to Visit: October to March.
Nearest City: Pune (110 km)
Temple Timings
How to Reach

It has a Trimbakeshwar, which is probably the strongest of the Shiva temples in the area, located next to the origin of the sacred Godavari River. The sanctum is also known to have a very unique lingam that is trident-shaped and is an emblem of Brahma and Vishnu in a single composite body with Mahesh.
Key Highlights
Best Time to Visit: All year
Nearest City: Nashik (28 km)
How to Reach

Grishneshwar Temple, which is near the Ellora Caves (UNESCO World Heritage), is the smallest of the Jyotirlingas but contains immeasurable religious seriousness. It also holds great importance in Indian ancient as well as modern history.
Key Highlights
Peak Season: October-March.
How to Reach

It is commonly believed that Aundha Nagnath is the first Jyotirlinga on earth; it holds a sacred status in the worshiping circles of Shaivites. The origin of the temple traces its roots to the Yadava dynasty, and thus, it has an archaeological relevance besides its spiritual value.
Key Highlights
Peak Season: October-March.
How to Reach:

Vaijnath is renowned and said to have curative qualities, which are expected to provide relief to maladies and moksha. The calm atmosphere and the holy ground confer peace to whoever lands within its walls.
Key Highlights
High Season: October to February.
How to Reach

All the temples are associated with Shaivism and special rituals and ceremonies. Rudrabhishek, Laghu Rudra, Maha Rudra, and Mahamrityunjaya Jaap are always performed frequently to request peace and prosperity. Trimbakeshwar Kaal Sarp Dosh Puja is highly attended and attracts numerous followers every month who seek astrological advice. It is believed by many that performing rituals at a Jyotirlinga brings the protection of God and transforms the inner personality.

Maharashtra has the largest number of Jyotirlingas in one state and is thus offering a unified pilgrimage itinerary. The connectivity, aviation, road transport, and railway infrastructure are efficient enough to reach every site. It is, therefore, a perfect place to visit in a Jyotirlinga tour package, where all five temples can be seen. The area provides a rich mixture of tradition, mythical accounts, and natural aesthetic beauty.

Maharashtra Panch Jyotirlinga Yatra has emerged as one of the best spiritual visits in India. All five temples are located within the same state; hence, people can complete the Yatra during a single visit. The pilgrimage has never been accessible in the past with the availability of better roads, hotels, and modes of traveling. The pilgrims declare that the trip transforms their lives as the Char Dham Yatra does in relation to spiritual power and fulfillment.

The vibrant temple markets around the Jyotirlingas are selling Rudraksha beads, brass idols, sacred ash, and handmade Pooja material. They contribute to the cultural diversity of the pilgrimage, and these products assist small craftsmen. Besides this, various local Maharashtrian meals, such as Misal Pav, Pithla Bhakri, Poha, and fresh sugarcane juice, can be enjoyed by the devotees as well, which makes the trip more entertaining.

The tourism department of the state and temple authorities have been striving to make all Jyotirlinga sites better in terms of provisions. The presence of new toilets, clean drinking water, shaded waiting bays, VIP queues, medical assistance, and food counters makes the visit comfortable for people of all ages. Along with this, crowd control and security are enhanced during major festivals such as Shravan, Mahashivratri, and Kartik Purnima to prevent loss of life of devotees.
Moreover, several IAS officers [RP1] have been appointed by the state government for direct oversight of religious infrastructure projects at this level.
Maharashtra is a major tourist destination in India, ranking 5th in domestic and 2nd in foreign tourist arrivals.
There are numerous tourist attractions around the temples, attracting a good crowd.
Let’s have a brief detail about the places you will cover and the day’s exploration schedule.
Note: You can also check our Maharashtra tour packages section to plan a stress-free pilgrimage.
Note: Bhimashankar trekking should be avoided during monsoons.
You need to make a checklist of the following travel tips to avoid last-minute hassle.
Q-1: How many Jyotirlingas are there in India? Ans- India boasts of 12 ancient Shiva shrines , each located in a different state.
Q-2: I am planning to visit Maharashtra next month. Is it possible to cover all 5 Jyotirlingas in 1 trip? Ans- Yes, if you are planning to spend at least a week there.
Q-3: I am travelling from Mumbai, so which Jyotirlinga would be the nearest to me? Ans- Trimbakeshwar is the nearest to Mumbai and is located at a distance of almost 175 km.

Q-4: What are some other activities that I can do after completing puja rituals? Ans- You can explore the nearby tourist attractions, do some street shopping, buy souvenirs for loved ones, and enjoy the nightlife of the city.
Q-5: Which was the first constructed/ancient Shiva site in Maharashtra? Ans- Aundha Nagnath Temple happens to be the most ancient architecture.
Q-6: Is VIP Darshan arrangement available? Ans- Yes, you can either arrange it yourself or ask your travel agency for the same.
Q-7: Can I travel with my parents to Bhimashankar Temple? Ans- Yes, but I would recommend you not to take the trekking route and rather opt for Palkis.
Q-8: I am coming from Nashik. Which place should I cover first? Ans- Trimbakeshwar is the Jyotirlinga near Nashik; hence, start your journey from there.

These Jyotirlingas are amongst the most ideal spots to experience the might and glory of Lord Shiva, should you be planning a pilgrimage, writing travel articles, or just learning about the spirituality of India. The Maharashtra Jyotirlinga Yatra is not a religious journey, but an awesome experience which nourishes the heart, mind, and spirit.
So, why the wait? Plan this spiritual journey with us and seek the blessings of Lord Shiva for love, protection, and divine serenity.
Har Har Mahadev!
